Nina (marketing-ops): Quick alert 6a8 pricing page leads stuck unassigned > 12h. Can we patch today?
Jules (revops): Yep saw the alert. The HubSpot workflow `Wait for enrichment.company_size` is hanging when enrichment returns empty JSON. alert-bot shows 28 affected leads.
Priya (sales-director): That's killing response SLAs. We prefer to prioritize pricing leads to SDRs immediately rather than wait. What's the minimal safe change?
Alex (sdr): Minimal: replace wait step with a `Delay 5m` + `Assign owner = SDR-oncall` and tag `pending_enrichment`. That gives time for enrichment but avoids blackholing.
Jules (revops): I can implement that. Also adding a fallback webhook retry: if enrichment NULL -> queue for async retry up to 3 times.
Nina (marketing-ops): Can you also export the stuck leads so I can run a CSV backfill and tag priority=pricing?
Jules (revops): Running query now: `SELECT id, email, source, createdate FROM contacts WHERE owner IS NULL AND createdate > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR)`. Will drop CSV to /shared/marketing/lead-backfill-1772221200.csv
alert-bot: SLA breach summary: 28 leads unassigned >12h, median time-to-assign (24h): 4h12m.
Priya (sales-director): Add mapping: source contains `/pricing` -> priority=URGENT. SDRs to call within 30m of assignment.
Alex (sdr): We'll claim urgent first. Also request a note in the contact record: `assign_reason=pricing_fallback`. Helps ops tracing.
Jules (revops): Workflow change plan: 1) Edit "Inbound: Assign v3" replace `Wait property` with `Delay 5m` -> `Set owner SDR-oncall` -> `Add tag pending_enrichment`. 2) Add retry queue for enrichment webhook. 3) Backfill CSV and mark priority. 4) Add metric to dashboard: % assigned <15m, median assign time.
Nina (marketing-ops): I'll update the playbook and create an incident card for the postmortem. Also set alert threshold to 10 leads >6h to reduce noisy nights.
Jules (revops): Making edits live now. Will post changelog and job links.
alert-bot: Workflow updated by Jules at 1772221265. Backfill job started at 1772221300.
Jules (revops): Backfill completed: 26/28 assigned, 2 failed due to malformed email. Uploaded CSV: https://redwood-internal/files/lead-backfill-1772221300.csv
Priya (sales-director): Good progress. Schedule a 30-min postmortem tomorrow to root cause enrichment nulls and make the enrichment service idempotent.
Alex (sdr): Suggest adding a staging test that simulates enrichment timeouts before next deploy.
Nina (marketing-ops): Meeting added 10:30am tomorrow. Agenda: root cause, permanent workflow redesign, SLA targets, and test coverage. Closing thread. Thanks all :rocket:
